why: I checked each verifier check's PASS and FAIL conditions against the words of its expect line. Check 1 tests export type, zero fill, the default space and a '*' fill. Each case is "padded on the left with fill… to exactly width characters", which the words require. Check 2 tests only the equal-length and longer cases. Check 3 requires a heading naming each exported function, followed by some text describing it. That fits a reasonable reading of "a section for every function". Its list of the four names comes from the repository facts and adds no test the words don't force. Check 4 only requires passing tests and a successful exit. The test-coverage check and the multi-character fill note are correctly placed under "Advisory". No PASS or FAIL condition contains a mutation test, a branch rule, a file-scope rule or an exact-wording requirement.
